consequence.statement: ApplicationSets will not trigger controller requeues on status changes, reducing unnecessary reconciliation overhead.

original.statement: ApplicationSets are no longer requeued when their status changes, preventing unnecessary reconciliation cycles.

decision.reason: [ev-35fad7c873dd] is a one-line bug-fix entry saying the ApplicationSet controller no longer requeues ApplicationSets when their status changes. That is a runtime behavior change in which nothing is said to fail, be rejected or need migrating, so behavior-change with low severity (review) is the strongest kind the evidence supports and does not over-claim mandatory work. The phrase "reducing unnecessary reconciliation overhead" is inferred, not stated, but it is a reasonable reading of "dont requeue", which is why confidence is low.
